title: Semion Mogilevich Was Born in Kyiv in 1946
description_short: Business Insider reports that Semion Mogilevich was born in Kyiv in 1946; the reviewed sources do not verify a birth day or explain this item’s place in a Trump timeline.
description_medium: Business Insider’s 2014 profile says Semion Mogilevich was born in Kyiv in 1946. It gives no month or day and does not mention Donald Trump. The FBI’s public announcement concerns Mogilevich’s alleged investor-fraud case and reports federal indictments in 2002 and 2003; it does not explain the birth entry’s place in a Trump timeline. TrumpFile supplies June 30 and an association claim, but neither point is independently established by the profile. This proposal keeps only the supported birth city and year.
description_long: Semion Mogilevich was born in Kyiv in 1946, according to Business Insider’s 2014 profile. The profile gives no month or day. The original TrumpFile article dates his birth to June 30, 1946, and separately describes him as an associate of Donald Trump and a fellow money launderer. Those are claims made by that article; the profile does not corroborate them. A focused search of official U.S. government sources located FBI materials about Mogilevich’s alleged YBM Magnex investor-fraud case. The FBI announcement reports federal indictments in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania in 2002 and 2003 and a reward for information leading to his arrest or conviction. It does not establish a connection to Trump or make the 1946 birth a Trump-related event. The narrower biographical fact is supported, but the evidence reviewed still does not explain the entry’s inclusion in a Trump timeline. The record remains on hold until that link is documented or the timeline scope changes.
